title: White Chicks
overview: Two disgraced FBI agents are assigned a new case where they must protect two cruise line heiresses from getting abducted.

title: Fast Five
overview: Fast Five is the fifth installment in The Fast and The Furious franchise. The film switches from car racing the chase sequences to a more standard crime thriller plot.

title: Hidden Figures
overview: Three female African-American mathematicians play a pivotal role in astronaut John Glenn's launch to orbit. Meanwhile, they also have to deal with racial and gender discrimination at work.

title: Catch Me If You Can
overview: Frank Abagnale Jr is a con man who poses as a pilot, doctor and lawyer and cashes forged cheques wort millions before his 21st birthday, despite being constantly chased by FBI agent Carl Hanratty.

title: Inception
overview: Cobb steals information from his targets by entering their dreams. he is wanted for his alleged role in his wife's murder and his only chance at redemption is to perform a nearly impossible task.

title: Just Go With It
overview: A plastic surgeon convinces his assistant to join him along with his young girlfriend on a trip to Hawaii and pose as his ex-wife to cover up a lie, but he ends up complicating the situation further.

title: Grown Ups
overview: When five highschool friends reunite for their coach's funeral, they decide to take a trip to the lake house where they celebrated their last win and are challenged by their rivals to another match.
